final: SELECT s1.weathprofile, s1.avg_bandwidth, s1.record_count, s1.avg_bandwidth - s2.overall_avg as difference FROM (SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as record_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile) s1 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_val) as overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) as avg_val FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile)) s2 ORDER BY s1.weathprofile
